title: Alaska Statutes, Title 23, Chapter 05 - Department of Labor and Workforce Development (wage payment and final pay)
source_id: AS 23.05.010 - 23.05.390 (final pay and pay periods at AS 23.05.140)

notes: Alaska has no severance entitlement and no state mini-WARN Act; employment is at will. AS 23.05.140 is the statute that bites on termination - it fixes when final wages must be paid after discharge or resignation and adds a penalty. Mass-layoff notice is federal (WARN Act, 29 U.S.C. s 2101 et seq.).
